name: xuanxing-shared
description: Shared rules for every 绚星 (Xuanxing) skill - connection and authorization checks, the response envelope, error-code handling, pagination and truncation, how to render platform links, and what must never be shown. Read this before using any other xuanxing-* skill. Also load it when a xuanxing tool returns UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN or UPSTREAM_ERROR, or when the user mentions 绚星 / 学习平台 / 连接绚星 / 授权 / 重新登录.
